spec_match.rationale: Five real hazards from a pagehide handler during removal, reproduced in default Chrome 159: self re-insert (NotFoundError plus a connected iframe whose contentWindow is null), self-remove (NotFoundError), sibling deleted, container detached during replaceChildren, and the container read mid-innerHTML. All are prevented with the flag.

interactive.rationale: Five experiment buttons each build a fresh tree, run the real removal, and append observed vs expected results to a table.

edge_cases.rationale: The page is about edge and failure behaviour; each case reports a thrown error, the final DOM and the connected state.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts coherence (breakage only when a handler ran) and, in omits mode, that no hazard occurs.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, polite verdict, captioned results table in a named region, visible focus.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb matches the ChromeStatus/HTML framing: stop synchronous pagehide/visibilitychange/unload on DOM removal of scriptable subframes; navigation unaffected.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5754395122860032 and the HTML 'destroy a child navigable' section.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 159.0.8149.0 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP verification): default launch and --enable-blink-features=OmitSubframeDetachmentEventsOnRemoval, each at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; every control driven, readouts changed, 0 console errors / page errors / failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow, post-interaction screenshots read. Chrome 153 (the default local browser) lacks the flag entirely and shows legacy behaviour under both switches. Not verified in a headed desktop Chrome, on a real Android device, or in Firefox/Safari.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (shared subframe-demo.css); buttons override background and colour together; status colours emerald-dark/rose on ivory/paper pass AA.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 in both modes; buttons ≥44px; checkboxes/radios are 24px but sit inside ≥44px labels; trace tables stack into labelled cards.

openQuestions.title: Add a MutationObserver view of the re-entrant mutations
openQuestions.detail: Recording MutationObserver records during each hazard would show the extra mutations the handler injected into the caller's single operation.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for async results log
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use one polite status region for discrete outcomes and role=log for histories; do not announce interstitial states; native labels/fieldset+legend.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Mode banner and verdicts are role=status aria-live=polite; histories are role=log; inputs labelled and grouped in fieldset/legend; buttons use aria-disabled with visible styling instead of losing focus.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with caption inside a role=region tabindex=0 wrapper named by the caption; stack into labelled cards via a container query on small widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Trace tables use caption + thead/th scope=col inside a named, focusable region; a @container (max-width:520px) rule stacks rows and injects data-label headers (set by subframe-kit.js from thead).

summary: Real-browser behavioural demo; outcomes come from removing actual subframes, and the mode is detected from observed behaviour, never the UA.
